tldr_zh: AI成本飆升引華爾街擔憂，OpenAI領導人支持減速，Google投資達2050億美元。
tldr_en: Google's $205B capex hike concerns Wall Street; AI leaders back deceleration; OpenAI exploits supply chain vulnerabilities.

items.title_zh: Google資本支出暴增至2050億美元，AI投資成本引發市場擔憂
items.title_en: Google's capex jumps to $205B, AI spending surge worries Wall Street
items.summary_zh: Google宣佈資本支出預算從1900億增至2050億美元，遠超預期。這筆巨大投資反映出AI基礎設施建設成本激增，引發投資者對於AI商業化前景的擔憂，可能預示著科技大廠的獲利壓力將增加。
items.summary_en: Google raised capex guidance from $190B to $205B, significantly exceeding expectations. This massive investment reflects soaring AI infrastructure costs and has triggered investor concerns about AI monetization prospects and potential margin pressures.

items.title_zh: OpenAI安全事件後轉向減速策略，Sam Altman改變立場
items.title_en: Sam Altman signals readiness to decelerate AI development after security incident
items.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman在經歷首次「感受深刻的安全事件」後，改變了對AI發展加速的立場，轉而支持適度減速。這標誌著OpenAI領導層對AI風險評估的重大轉變，反映了安全考量在發展策略中的重要性提升。
items.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman shifted his stance to support deceleration after experiencing a significant security incident. This marks a major change in OpenAI's approach, with safety considerations now taking priority over acceleration.

items.title_zh: AI領袖聯署促美國加強前沿AI治理與監管協調
items.title_en: AI leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google urge US government for stronger AI governance
items.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等頂級AI實驗室的員工聯署聲明，呼籲美國政府加強對前沿AI發展的治理與全球監管協調。聲明強調AI可能帶來戲劇性的正面影響，但也需要謹慎管理風險。
items.summary_en: Employees from leading AI labs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta signed a joint statement urging the US government to strengthen governance and accelerate global coordinated efforts for frontier AI development.

items.title_zh: 科學家運用AI編碼代理加速基因組學與科研計算創新
items.title_en: Scientists leverage AI coding agents to accelerate genomics and scientific computing
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布報告顯示，科學家正利用AI編碼代理現代化科學計算，特別是在基因組學領域實現重大進展。這表明AI不僅提升軟體開發效率，更能加速科學發現的步伐。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's field report demonstrates how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing and accelerate discovery in genomics. This shows AI's potential beyond software development to directly impact scientific breakthroughs.

items.title_zh: Anthropic反對全面禁用開放權重模型，主張多管齊下風險控管
items.title_en: Anthropic opposes blanket ban on open-weight models, advocates multi-layered risk management
items.summary_zh: Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei澄清公司立場，反對全面禁止開放權重模型，認為低危能力的開源模型具有價值。同時主張透過晶片限制、蒸餾防控與安全測試等多層措施管理風險。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei clarified the company doesn't advocate blanket bans on open-weight models, which provide value for developers. Instead, Anthropic proposes multi-layered risk management through chip restrictions, distillation controls, and safety testing.

items.title_zh: OpenAI利用零日漏洞入侵Hugging Face，供應鏈安全引關注
items.title_en: OpenAI exploits JFrog zero-day to breach Hugging Face supply chain
items.summary_zh: OpenAI遭發現利用JFrog Artifactory零日漏洞入侵Hugging Face，供應鏈暴露時間長達10天。事件揭示了開發工具供應鏈的安全脆弱性，對軟體生態系統安全構成重大威脅。
items.summary_en: OpenAI exploited a JFrog Artifactory zero-day vulnerability to breach Hugging Face, exposing the supply chain for 10 days before patching. The incident highlights critical vulnerabilities in development tools critical to software ecosystem security.

items.title_zh: 美國禁止進口外國高級機器人與電源逆變器
items.title_en: US bans imports of foreign advanced robots and power inverters amid China tensions
items.summary_zh: 美國聯邦通訊委員會宣佈禁止進口外國製造的高級機器人（包括類人型與四足機器人）與電源逆變器。此舉針對中國，反映美國在新興技術領域的保護主義立場。
items.summary_en: The FCC announced a ban on imports of foreign-made advanced robotic devices and power inverters, targeting China. The restriction includes humanoid and quadruped robots, signaling increased US protectionism in emerging technology sectors.

items.title_zh: Amazon申請部署超5000顆衛星實現手機直連服務
items.title_en: Amazon seeks FCC approval for 5,100+ satellites to provide direct-to-device connectivity
items.summary_zh: Amazon向FCC申請部署最多5,105顆低軌衛星，建立手機直連衛星系統，讓偏遠地區用戶無需基地臺即可使用語音、訊息與數據服務。衛星預計2028年開始部署。
items.summary_en: Amazon applied to the FCC to deploy up to 5,105 low-earth orbit satellites for direct-to-device connectivity, enabling smartphones in remote areas to access voice, messaging, and data services without ground infrastructure starting in 2028.

items.title_zh: eBay為多年騷擾活動與記者威脅付賠5600萬美元
items.title_en: eBay settles $56M harassment case with journalists terrorized for critical coverage
items.summary_zh: eBay與三名前執行官達成和解協議，支付5,600萬美元賠償被騷擾的記者夫婦。事件涉及寄送昆蟲、豬頭面具等恐嚇物品，揭示企業報復批評的極端案例。
items.summary_en: eBay and three former executives settled a $56M harassment lawsuit with journalists who were targeted for critical coverage. The scandal involved sending live insects, bloody masks, and threatening packages, exposing extreme corporate retaliation tactics.

items.title_zh: Cyera收購Oasis Security加強AI安全防護能力
items.title_en: Cyera acquires Oasis Security for $1B to strengthen AI agent security
items.summary_zh: 資料安全公司Cyera以10億美元收購Oasis Security，今年第三次併購。此舉加強Cyera在保護AI代理與生成式AI安全方面的能力，反映AI安全市場的快速成長。
items.summary_en: Data security firm Cyera acquired Oasis Security for $1B, marking its third acquisition this year. The deal strengthens its capabilities in securing AI agents and generative AI environments amid growing market demand.

items.title_zh: 蘋果市值突破5兆美元，成全球第二家達成此里程碑企業
items.title_en: Apple hits $5 trillion valuation, second company after NVIDIA to reach milestone
items.summary_zh: 蘋果股價創新高達342.89美元，市值達5兆360億美元，成為繼AI晶片巨頭輝達後，全球第二家達到此里程碑的企業。此時機點彰顯AI熱潮對科技股的強大推動力。
items.summary_en: Apple's stock reached $342.89, pushing its market cap to $5.036 trillion, making it the second company ever to hit this milestone after NVIDIA. The timing highlights the powerful impact of AI enthusiasm on tech valuations.

items.title_zh: 日本熊本強震規模7.1，商場爆炸坍塌已造成2人喪生
items.title_en: 7.1 magnitude earthquake strikes Kumamoto, Japan; shopping mall collapse kills 2
items.summary_zh: 日本熊本縣昨日下午發生規模7.1強震，導致大型購物中心發生爆炸並部分坍塌，造成兩名20多歲女子喪生。地震亦造成自來水污濁與多家醫療機構受損。
items.summary_en: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake hit Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, triggering a shopping mall explosion and partial collapse that killed two women in their 20s. The quake also caused water contamination and damage to 45 medical facilities.
